spec_case: issue #503 (native Ollama, soft preflight plus the exit-7 hint)
description: A prompt naming 'provider: ollama' with on_error: skip, against an unreachable host: preflight downgrades to a soft warning and the run proceeds, leaving meta.error holding the exit-7 failure text and hint; curl's own stderr clause there is matched by pattern (third_party_text), not byte-for-byte.

third_party_text.pattern: All adapter attempts failed: \[\{'adapter': 'ollama', 'model': 'test-model', 'status': 'failed', 'error': \"ollama request failed \(curl exit 7\) model='test-model' url=http://127\.0\.0\.1:1/api/generate: .*? Ollama at http://127\.0\.0\.1:1 is not reachable\. Start it \(`ollama serve`\), or set `runtime\.adapters\.ollama\.base_url` in your config\. Run `cof doctor` to verify connectivity\.\".*

ollama request failed \(curl exit 7\) model='test-model' url=http://127\.0\.0\.1:1/api/generate: .*? Ollama at http://127\.0\.0\.1:1 is not reachable\. Start it \(`ollama serve`\), or set `runtime\.adapters\.ollama\.base_url` in your config\. Run `cof doctor` to verify connectivity\.
